'import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. COPY POWER BI DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = [str(column) for column in df.columns]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DEFINE FIELDS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

date_field = "date"
alcohol_field = "alcohol_consumption_count"

preferred_metrics = [
    "sleep_hours",
    "sleep_deep_hours",
    "sleep_rem_hours",
    "hrv_ms",
    "heart_rate_avg",
    "wrist_temperature_f",
    "blood_oxygen_pct",
    "active_energy_kcal",
    "steps",
    "workout_minutes"
]

label_map = {
    "sleep_hours": "Sleep",
    "sleep_deep_hours": "Deep Sleep",
    "sleep_rem_hours": "REM Sleep",
    "hrv_ms": "HRV",
    "heart_rate_avg": "Average HR",
    "wrist_temperature_f": "Wrist Temp",
    "blood_oxygen_pct": "Blood Oxygen",
    "active_energy_kcal": "Active Energy",
    "steps": "Steps",
    "workout_minutes": "Workout Min"
}

column_lookup = {
    column.lower(): column
    for column in df.columns
}

if date_field not in column_lookup:
    raise ValueError("date is missing from the visual.")

if alcohol_field not in column_lookup:
    raise ValueError("alcohol_consumption_count is missing from the visual.")

actual_date_field = column_lookup[date_field]
actual_alcohol_field = column_lookup[alcohol_field]

available_metrics = [
    column_lookup[metric]
    for metric in preferred_metrics
    if metric in column_lookup
]

if len(available_metrics) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No usable outcome metrics were found.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CLEAN TYPES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df[actual_date_field] = pd.to_datetime(df[actual_date_field], errors="coerce")
df[actual_alcohol_field] = pd.to_numeric(df[actual_alcohol_field], errors="coerce")

for metric in available_metrics:
    df[metric] = pd.to_numeric(df[metric], errors="coerce")

df = df.dropna(subset=[actual_date_field, actual_alcohol_field]).copy()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. BUILD NEXT-DAY DATASET
#    Match today''s drinks to tomorrow''s metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

left_df = df[[actual_date_field, actual_alcohol_field]].copy()
left_df["next_date"] = left_df[actual_date_field] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)

right_df = df[[actual_date_field] + available_metrics].copy()
right_df = right_df.rename(columns={actual_date_field: "next_date"})

next_day_metric_names = {}
for metric in available_metrics:
    new_name = f"next_day__{metric}"
    next_day_metric_names[metric] = new_name

right_df = right_df.rename(columns=next_day_metric_names)

analysis_df = left_df.merge(right_df, on="next_date", how="left")

next_day_metric_columns = list(next_day_metric_names.values())

# Keep only rows with at least one next-day metric
analysis_df = analysis_df.dropna(
    subset=next_day_metric_columns,
    how="all"
).copy()

# Keep only nonnegative alcohol counts
analysis_df = analysis_df[
    analysis_df[actual_alcohol_field] >= 0
].copy()

analysis_df[actual_alcohol_field] = (
    analysis_df[actual_alcohol_field]
    .round()
    .astype(int)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CREATE DRINK BUCKETS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def bucket_drinks(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return np.nan
    if x == 0:
        return "0"
    elif x == 1:
        return "1"
    elif x == 2:
        return "2"
    else:
        return "3+"

analysis_df["drink_bucket"] = analysis_df[actual_alcohol_field].apply(bucket_drinks)

bucket_order = ["0", "1", "2", "3+"]

analysis_df["drink_bucket"] = pd.Categorical(
    analysis_df["drink_bucket"],
    categories=bucket_order,
    ordered=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. CALCULATE GROUP MEANS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

group_means = (
    analysis_df
    .groupby("drink_bucket")[next_day_metric_columns]
    .mean()
    .reindex(bucket_order)
)

group_counts = (
    analysis_df
    .groupby("drink_bucket")
    .size()
    .reindex(bucket_order)
    .fillna(0)
    .astype(int)
)

if "0" not in group_means.index or group_means.loc["0"].isna().all():
    raise ValueError("You need at least some 0-drink days to create a sober baseline.")

baseline = group_means.loc["0"]

# Percent change for colors
baseline_safe = baseline.replace(0, np.nan)

percent_change = (
    group_means
    .sub(baseline, axis=1)
    .div(baseline_safe.abs(), axis=1)
    * 100
)

# Raw deltas for cell text
raw_delta = group_means.sub(baseline, axis=1)

# Force baseline column to display as zero-color
percent_change.loc["0"] = 0
raw_delta.loc["0"] = 0

# Transpose so rows = metrics, columns = drink buckets
heatmap_pct = percent_change.T
heatmap_delta = raw_delta.T
means_df = group_means.T

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. CLEAN LABELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reverse_metric_lookup = {
    v: k for k, v in next_day_metric_names.items()
}

base_metric_order = [
    reverse_metric_lookup[col] for col in heatmap_pct.index
]

row_labels = [
    label_map.get(metric.lower(), metric.replace("_", " ").title())
    for metric in base_metric_order
]

column_labels = [
    f"{bucket} drinks\n(n={group_counts.get(bucket, 0)})"
    for bucket in heatmap_pct.columns
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. HEATMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize=(15, 5.5)
)

values = heatmap_pct.values

max_abs = np.nanmax(np.abs(values))
if np.isnan(max_abs) or max_abs < 5:
    color_limit = 10
else:
    color_limit = min(40, np.ceil(max_abs / 5) * 5)

heatmap = ax.imshow(
    values,
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    vmin=-color_limit,
    vmax=color_limit,
    aspect="auto"
)

ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(column_labels)))
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(row_labels)))

ax.set_xticklabels(column_labels, fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels, fontsize=10)

ax.set_title(
    "How Today''s Drinking Changes Tomorrow''s Metrics",
    fontsize=17,
    fontweight="bold",
    pad=18
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. FORMAT CELL TEXT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def format_mean(metric, value):
    metric_lower = metric.lower()

    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""

    if metric_lower in ["steps", "active_energy_kcal"]:
        return f"{value:.0f}"
    elif metric_lower in ["workout_minutes"]:
        return f"{value:.0f}"
    elif metric_lower in ["blood_oxygen_pct", "wrist_temperature_f"]:
        return f"{value:.1f}"
    elif metric_lower in ["heart_rate_avg", "hrv_ms"]:
        return f"{value:.1f}"
    else:
        return f"{value:.2f}"

def format_delta(metric, value):
    metric_lower = metric.lower()

    if pd.isna(value):
        return "—"

    if metric_lower in ["sleep_hours", "sleep_deep_hours", "sleep_rem_hours"]:
        return f"{value:+.2f} h"
    elif metric_lower in ["hrv_ms"]:
        return f"{value:+.1f} ms"
    elif metric_lower in ["heart_rate_avg"]:
        return f"{value:+.1f} bpm"
    elif metric_lower in ["wrist_temperature_f"]:
        return f"{value:+.2f}°F"
    elif metric_lower in ["blood_oxygen_pct"]:
        return f"{value:+.1f} pts"
    elif metric_lower in ["active_energy_kcal"]:
        return f"{value:+.0f} kcal"
    elif metric_lower in ["steps"]:
        return f"{value:+.0f}"
    elif metric_lower in ["workout_minutes"]:
        return f"{value:+.0f} min"
    else:
        return f"{value:+.2f}"

for i in range(heatmap_pct.shape[0]):
    for j in range(heatmap_pct.shape[1]):
        pct = heatmap_pct.iloc[i, j]
        delta = heatmap_delta.iloc[i, j]
        mean_value = means_df.iloc[i, j]

        base_metric = base_metric_order[i]

        if pd.isna(mean_value):
            display_text = "—"
            text_color = "black"
        else:
            if j == 0:
                display_text = f"Baseline\n{format_mean(base_metric, mean_value)}"
            else:
                display_text = (
                    f"{format_delta(base_metric, delta)}\n"
                    f"{format_mean(base_metric, mean_value)}"
                )

            text_color = "white" if abs(pct) >= color_limit * 0.45 else "black"

        ax.text(
            j,
            i,
            display_text,
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=8.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=text_color
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. GRIDLINES / STYLING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-0.5, len(column_labels), 1), minor=True)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-0.5, len(row_labels), 1), minor=True)

ax.grid(which="minor", color="white", linewidth=1.5)
ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)

for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

colorbar = fig.colorbar(
    heatmap,
    ax=ax,
    fraction=0.035,
    pad=0.03
)

colorbar.set_label(
    "% change vs. next-day sober baseline",
    rotation=270,
    labelpad=18
)

fig.text(
    0.5,
    0.01,
    "Color shows percent change vs. 0-drink days. Cell text shows raw next-day change and the bucket average underneath.",
    ha="center",
    fontsize=9
)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.04, 1, 1])
plt.show()'
